<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“Benri Vallenar. We are here to extend an invitation on behalf of the Iron King.”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|— ''The Captain'', chapter 20}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Iron King Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Iron King]] is a powerful entity and the leader of the [[Iron Legion]], a group that spreads through underground factories known as [[Scourge Warrens]] by converting organic and mechanical matter into soldiers. The King possesses a transcendent intellect and functions as a galaxy-spanning hive mind, granting him virtually limitless resources. He maintains an unprecedented connection to his [[Legion]], which allows him to enhance or integrate magic and prevents him from experiencing physical, mental, or magical exhaustion. Physically, the King is a metallic being with exposed organs and circuits that requires time to mature and heal. His presence is characterized by immense weight, intense heat similar to a [[Furnace|furnace]], and a radiating confidence. Historically, the King has been thought dead or hidden, but he is capable of resurrection through specific devices. He has been known to interact with powerful mages and leaders, sometimes acting as an adversary or a highly capable ally.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|This ten-foot-tall, two-ton cyborg is a masterwork fusion of flesh and [[steel]]. He possesses a head much larger than a human's with an unbreakable glass skull that reveals a brain flickering like sparks of light, and his eyes are burning portals of magical flame. His physical form includes a metal [[skeleton]] hand and is characterized by open circuits, exposed organs, and a network of veins and wires.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A highly intelligent leader of the [[Iron Legion]], this entity has made bids for galactic control and seeks to claim [[The Last Horizon]]. He is an overwhelming presence that can be both sparing, as seen with the narrator's father, and a source of profound terror for others. He is capable of engaging in one-on-one conversations and holds high opinions regarding certain magical abilities.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Iron King]] has harmed the narrator and spared their father. He once pierced [[Varic Vallenar]]'s chest, and [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]] is able to use magic to locate him. He attempted to manipulate the [[Aether]]-connection of [[Eurias]] before releasing them to fight a [[Divine Titan]]. Nelthan lives in fear of him, while [[Benri Vallenar]] has engaged in a one-on-one conversation with the entity and signed a magical contract with him. Additionally, [[Omega]] claimed to have taken control of the [[Iron]] King, and [[Sola Kalter|Sola]] earned Units for his death.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As a mage, he utilizes pink-and-orange [[Aether]]-disrupting magic to channel, augment, and control the powers of others. His repertoire includes sending out psionic pulses, expanding the [[Mirror of Silence]] spell, and attempting to twist [[Aether]]-connections. He possesses a built-in magnification system and can draw upon the processing power of the entire [[Legion]].}}

== History ==

{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|[[The Iron King]] is a ten-foot-tall, incomprehensible cyborg that serves as a high-level leader within the [[Iron Legion]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c1">''The Captain'', chapter 1</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c19">''The Captain'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c20">''The Captain'', chapter 20</ref> His birth is being facilitated by a weapon aboard the [[Iron Hive]], though his consciousness was interrupted during this process.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c3">''The Captain'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c18">''The Captain'', chapter 18</ref> Contained within a torpedo, this mature entity previously led the expansion of the [[Iron Legion]] and killed the narrator in a prior life.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c3" /> While he was once unborn when the [[Absolute Burial]] spell was used on him, his body was eventually sealed and launched into a star.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c8">''The Captain'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c18" /> The current [[Iron]] King is the fifth of his kind to be created, marking a rare occurrence as the [[Legion]] has only successfully produced four minds in the past.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c18" /> This fifth iteration is linked more closely to the [[Legion]] than his predecessors and currently lies strapped to a [[steel]] table with exposed organs and open circuits.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c18" /> He is a highly intelligent masterwork of flesh and [[steel]] whose presence carries the temperature of a [[Furnace|furnace]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c28">''The Captain'', chapter 28</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c34">''The Captain'', chapter 34</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Conflict with the crew}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|[[The Iron King]] is a lethal entity capable of killing people and damaging protections during battle.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c3">''The Engineer'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c30">''The Engineer'', chapter 30</ref> Following the recent [[destruction]] of an [[Iron]] King, rumors circulated that one was leading the [[Iron Legion]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c5">''The Engineer'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c8">''The Engineer'', chapter 8</ref> This specific being, which posed a mortal threat to the Captain and was fought by [[Horizon]], was eventually killed by the crew.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c18">''The Engineer'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c25">''The Engineer'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c33">''The Engineer'', chapter 33</ref> [[Sola Kalter|Sola]] earned Units for this kill, though the entity is not currently ready to be born.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c21">''The Engineer'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c32">''The Engineer'', chapter 32</ref> While [[Omega]] claimed to have taken over the [[Iron]] King, this figure had previously spared the narrator's father.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c36">''The Engineer'', chapter 36</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c38">''The Engineer'', chapter 38</ref> Furthermore, an [[Iron]] King that controlled the entire [[Legion]] possessed the power to capture [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]]'s father.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c41">''The Engineer'', chapter 41</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Iron King]] is a mysterious entity associated with [[Benri Vallenar|Benri]]'s need for guards and the magical contract they once signed.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c2">''The Pilot'', chapter 2</ref> Although this figure was completely destroyed, the narrator has experienced fear ever since their battle with the entity.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c8">''The Pilot'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c10">''The Pilot'', chapter 10</ref> [[The Perfected]] sought to create an [[Iron]] King, and research concerning this process is stored within the [[data core]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c20">''The Pilot'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c25">''The Pilot'', chapter 25</ref> As the final [[Iron]] King in the galaxy, its [[destruction]] was followed by the first appearance of an [[Iron]] King in centuries.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c22">''The Pilot'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c23">''The Pilot'', chapter 23</ref> This apocalyptic enemy brought the narrator to the brink of death, yet [[Sola Kalter|Sola]]'s crew contains individuals capable of dueling such a foe.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c26">''The Pilot'', chapter 26</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c32">''The Pilot'', chapter 32</ref> The entity is characterized by a metal smile and a visible brain that flickers like sparks of light, even as it claimed the game was not yet over.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c38">''The Pilot'', chapter 38</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">12</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Iron King]] is a figure mentioned in relation to [[Benri Vallenar|Benri]]'s desire for guards.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Iron King]] is a mysterious entity that previously made [[Benri Vallenar|Benri]] sign a magical contract.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Iron King]] was completely destroyed.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The narrator has been afraid of something since their battle with the [[Iron King]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Perfected]] were attempting to create an [[Iron King]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Iron King]] was the final [[Iron King]] in the galaxy.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|An [[Iron King]] has appeared for the first time in centuries.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[data core]] contains research regarding the creation of the [[Iron King]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Iron King]] is an apocalyptic enemy who has brought the narrator to the brink of death.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c26" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Sola Kalter|Sola]]'s crew includes people who can duel an [[Iron King]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c32" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Iron King]] has a metal smile and visible brain that flickers like sparks of light.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c38" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Iron King]] stated that the game has not ended yet.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c38" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Containment in Aethertech}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Iron Legion]] currently operates without an [[Iron]] King to coordinate its various [[Hives]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c39">''The Pilot'', chapter 39</ref> [[Benri Vallenar]] has personally engaged in a one-on-one conversation with this figure, who is presently contained within an [[Aethertech box]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c39" /> Furthermore, the [[Iron]] King is a being that Vallenar has the [[Authority|authority]] to grant permission to use.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c39" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Iron Legion]] lacks an [[Iron King]] to coordinate its [[Hives]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c39" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Iron King]] is a figure [[Benri Vallenar]] has had a one-on-one conversation with.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c39" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Iron King]] is contained within an [[Aethertech box]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c39" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Iron King]] is a being that [[Benri Vallenar]] can give permission to use.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c39" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“Benri Vallenar. We are here to extend an invitation on behalf of the Iron King.”<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c20" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“If they did have a King, as rumors suggested, they must have lost him.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“First I got to take over the Iron King, and now you?<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c36" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“I’m on a crew with people who can duel an Iron King.”<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c32" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Iron King said, “It seems our game hasn’t ended quite yet.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c38" />}}
